prospect.name: Ken Dunham
prospect.training_background: Trains 5-6 days a week in a home gym with cables and dumbbells; upper body and some squats. Started kettlebells roughly two weeks before the call and reports early core changes.
prospect.medical: Torn meniscus in the left knee limiting running and knee-loaded movement

signals: Already training 5-6 days a week with a home gym; frames the goal as trimming remaining visceral fat and gaining muscle rather than rescue
Call ended at 7:53 before goals, offer or price were reached, so the avatar read is based on a single opening answer

goals.text: Trim the visceral fat that has crept on over the last 10-20 years
Gain muscle — has already added size in arms, chest and shoulders in the last year
Make real progress in six months with kettlebells

pains.text: Visceral fat has slowly crept up over the last 10-20 years despite eating right and training 5-6 days a week
Torn meniscus in the left knee makes running and a lot of knee movement hard

evidence: Rep's internet failed repeatedly and the call was abandoned at 00:07:53: 'Any chance we could reschedule a little bit later today and I'll make sure I'm somewhere where I can actually have proper service'
Prospect agreed to a re-booked slot at 6pm Central and the rep said he would send an updated calendar invite
No discovery beyond the opening question, no offer, no price
outcome.next_step: Reconvene the same day at 6pm Central on an updated calendar invite

notable.note: Aborted call. The rep had moved to Brazil a week earlier and lost connectivity twice inside eight minutes, costing the discovery. Prospect is 63 with a torn meniscus and is already self-prescribing kettlebell work; a full medical screen is owed on the re-run.

quality.notes: Short turns are inverted around the connectivity breaks — 'Ken, can you hear me all right? I can.' is labelled to the rep but contains both sides. Role was read from content throughout.
